text:
[Council File 26-1140; CD 14]
Motion (Jurado, Yaroslavsky – Blumenfield) relative to funding for the retention of a consultant to conduct a feasibility study that evaluates zoo governance models and identifies the models that may work best for the City and the Los Angeles Zoo, along with a roadmap for potential implementation of a governance change.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 9, 2026)
